reason: In sync mode, parseRefreshTokenResponse checks the response against minimumTokenResponseSchema (parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts:189-195). That schema's computed keys both become the literal string "[object Object]", so the plain z.object keeps only access_token and drops expires_in. As a result, office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts:264-271 keeps and saves the old, expired expires_in, and getToken's isExpired check (line 279) triggers another refresh on every new service instance.
